global: Cinematic documentary score: modern hybrid orchestral, warm analog synth pulses, felt piano, deep low strings, soft mallets, subtle organic percussion, rich wide stereo, high-end production. Instrumental only, no vocals, no choir words, no lead melody that competes with a male narrator; keep the 1-4 kHz range sparse; no ukulele, no steel guitar, no tiki or luau cliches; clean ending without a fade-out tail

conventions.gain_db: mix.json music gain (ep01 used -9 for every bed); ducked -11 dB under the voice
conventions.dur: window length; music.py requests dur+3 s
conventions.offset: set after generation so each sync point lands (music editing)
conventions.sections: optional ElevenLabs composition-plan sections with duration_ms (music.py sends only the prompt today; see spot_notes.md). Sections under about 3 s (M04 held breath) may be refused: then merge them into the next section and make the dropout with the dip

cues.emotion: wonder at the drain, playful curiosity, then the pull of the deep
cues.prompt: Cold open of a wonder documentary: an airy, curious pulse at 96 bpm in D Lydian, felt piano and soft synth arpeggios, light and bright from the first beat; gentle low strings join and build to a warm open arrival, then a lighter playful stretch, then the pulse drops an octave into something deep and mysterious with a simple three-note descending felt-piano figure (the look-down motif), a slow rising swell, and it thins to a single soft sustained pad at the end. No intro sting, no big drums.
